**Void Deck now keeps the game menu whole.** Because Void Deck replaces Steam's Home screen, it also has to
rebuild the game menu that goes with it — and everything other plugins add to that menu used to disappear with
it. The entries are back, in the same place Steam shows them.

**Change artwork comes back.** If you have the SteamGridDB plugin installed, **Change artwork** appears in the
game menu again and opens SteamGridDB's own artwork page for that game, exactly like the plugin's own entry did.
Void Deck only offers it when the plugin is actually there, so the button never leads to a blank page.

**Manage is back too.** The game menu now carries a **Manage** submenu with **Controller configuration** (for the
games that support it) and **Uninstall**, the two entries Steam's own menu has.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.5.4.zip` from the [v1.5.4 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.5.4), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
